semiconductor_relevance: Low — JDV Control Valves specializes in flow control components and valves, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: JDV Control Valves Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures a range of valves and flow control components, primarily serving industries such as petrochemical and power plants. While their products are essential for various industrial applications, they do not specifically cater to the semiconductor sector.

regional_presence.China: JDV Control Valves (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a wholly-owned subsidiary responsible for product marketing and technical services in mainland China.
